An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. This striking one-owner 2024 Mercedes-Benz GLS 450 4MATIC commands attention the moment it arrives, finished in the exclusive MANUFAKTUR Alpine Grey that delivers a sophisticated, metallic depth rarely seen on the road. The Night Package deepens its presence with a deliberate dark elegance—gloss black accents sweeping across the grille, window surrounds, and exterior details, paired with matte black roof rails that give the flagship SUV a stealthy, assertive stance. The AMG Line Exterior Package amplifies the drama with sculpted AMG body styling, a more aggressive front apron and rear diffuser treatment, and a sport brake system whose calipers proudly display Mercedes-Benz lettering. Rolling on distinctive 21-inch AMG Twin 5-Spoke wheels with black accents and illuminated brushed aluminum running boards that light the way at night, it looks every bit the elevated, athletic luxury SUV.

Step inside and the cabin continues the refined contrast. Macchiato Beige and black MB-Tex upholstery creates a warm, inviting atmosphere, complemented by a matching Macchiato Beige headliner and the rich, organic beauty of Natural Grain Brown Walnut trim. The six-passenger configuration with second-row captain’s chairs transforms the interior into a first-class lounge, offering exceptional comfort, easy access to the third row, and a sense of private space that makes every journey feel special. A multifunction sports steering wheel wrapped in nappa leather sits ready in your hands, heated for cool mornings, while AMG floor mats add a sporty finishing touch underfoot.

Beneath the surface, the GLS 450 delivers effortless capability. Its advanced 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-six mild-hybrid powertrain produces a refined yet potent 375 horsepower, channeled through a silky 9-speed automatic and the confidence of 4MATIC all-wheel drive. The standard AIRMATIC air suspension glides over imperfect roads with composed luxury, while the available trailer hitch and increased towing capacity stand ready for weekend adventures or towing duties. Live Traffic keeps you informed on the move, and the Advanced Plus Package layers in the sophisticated technology, comfort, and driver-assistance features expected of a Mercedes-Benz flagship.

With a clean one-owner history and a carefully chosen suite of options that elevate both presence and practicality, this GLS 450 is ready to become the centerpiece of your next chapter on the road.

description: COMMANDING, LUXURIOUS, SPACIOUS, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, FIRST-CLASS TRAVEL FOR SEVEN! Black Raven paint, polished 22'' wheels, and a Brandy and Dark Atmosphere leather cabin give this 2022 Cadillac Escalade Premium Luxury the kind of presence that makes a statement the moment it rolls up. It is a one-owner example with a long, regular service record, much of it at the Cadillac dealer that originally sold it, and the odometer is hovering around the 78,100-mile mark. The Escalade has always been Cadillac's flagship, and this generation backs up its looks with a big, quiet, technology-rich cabin and effortless V8 power. Seating for seven and a cargo area that grows to more than 120 cubic feet make the Escalade as practical as it is impressive, so it works equally well as a family hauler, a business-travel shuttle, or a road-trip machine. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Escalade has defined the full-size luxury SUV for decades, and the latest generation is a major leap forward. It combines a commanding presence and a rich, beautifully finished cabin with a ride that is smooth and composed, plus the kind of room that few vehicles can match. Buyers who cross-shop the Lincoln Navigator, Lexus LX, and Mercedes-Benz GLS often choose the Escalade for its bold styling, its generous space for passengers and cargo, and the sense of occasion that comes with every drive. The 2022 model also carries one of the largest and most advanced displays in any production vehicle, a curved OLED screen that spans much of the dashboard, along with a premium audio system and a rich suite of driver-assistance technologies. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Reviewers have consistently praised this generation of the Escalade for its strong power, commanding road presence, luxurious comfort, and advanced technology, and the 2022 model earned a 2022 CONSUMER GUIDE BEST BUY in the premium large SUV category. The consensus is that it is a vehicle for buyers who want luxury, technology, and cabin space above all else. Warranty This Escalade currently shows 78,131 miles. Cadillac's original factory coverage has expired, so this SUV is offered on its own merits, and the record is encouraging. CARFAX shows 13 service records, including regular maintenance inspections, frequent oil and filter changes, a brake fluid exchange at 33,954 miles, a coolant exchange at 47,756 miles, and a recent oil change and tire rotation in May 2026. CARFAX also notes that most of its service was performed by the Cadillac dealer that sold it new. Extended service plans may be available for buyers who want added peace of mind. Standard Features The Premium Luxury is a rich step up in finish and technology from the base Luxury trim. It brings the 22'' polished 14-spoke wheels, the power panoramic sunroof, the AKG Studio 19-speaker audio system, heated and ventilated front seats, power-adjustable second-row bucket seats with heating, and a head-up display, so the Escalade feels equipped for any journey. A rear camera mirror, wireless device charging, and a heated steering wheel add everyday convenience, and a mechanical limited-slip differential helps put the power down in slippery conditions. Installed Options Brandy and Dark Atmosphere Accents with Full Leather Seats A richly colored interior with full leather seating that elevates the cabin and gives it a custom, high-end feel. Mechanical Features A 6.2-liter V8 delivers 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque through a 10-speed automatic transmission, and the result is a big, confident engine that makes light work of highway merging, passing, and hauling a full load of passengers. The power arrives smoothly and effortlessly, and the V8's deep, refined sound adds to the sense of occasion. Rear-wheel drive and a mechanical limited-slip differential give the Escalade a balanced, traditional feel, and the EPA estimates 14 mpg in the city, 19 on the highway, and 16 combined. Independent rear suspension helps the Escalade ride smoothly and quietly over rough pavement, and the steering and brakes give the driver confidence in a vehicle of this size. It is a big SUV that drives with calm and composure, and it is happiest on long stretches of highway. Exterior Features Black Raven paint gives this Escalade a deep, glossy look that suits its flagship status, and the vertical LED headlamps and tail lamps, illuminated door handles, and polished 22'' 14-spoke wheels add distinctive Cadillac style. The SUV measures about 211.9 inches long, 81.1 inches wide, and 76.7 inches tall on a 120.9-inch wheelbase, a size that gives it real presence while keeping it manageable in everyday driving. IntelliBeam automatic high beams and rain-sensing wipers keep things safe and easy at night and in bad weather. Assist steps make getting in and out easier, and the hands-free power liftgate opens with a wave of the foot when your arms are full of groceries or luggage. The power panoramic sunroof fills the cabin with light. Interior Features The Escalade's cabin is one of the roomiest in the segment, with seating for seven in comfort. Heated and ventilated front seats offer the driver and front passenger a luxurious perch, with memory settings for the driver's seat, mirrors, and steering column, and the front row offers about 44.5 inches of legroom and 42.3 inches of headroom. Power-adjustable second-row bucket seats are heated and offer about 41.7 inches of legroom, so rear passengers can stretch out, and the 60/40 split third-row bench power-folds and still offers about 34.9 inches of legroom and 38.2 inches of headroom, which is generous for a third row. Cargo space is equally impressive. There are about 25.5 cubic feet behind the third row, enough for luggage or a week's groceries with all seven seats in use, and about 72.9 cubic feet behind the second row with the third row folded flat. With both rear rows folded, the cargo area grows to about 121 cubic feet, which is enough for furniture, sports equipment, or a trip to the home improvement store. The power-folding third row makes reconfiguring the space a push-button job. Brandy and Dark Atmosphere accents with full leather seating give the cabin a warm, upscale look, and tri-zone automatic climate control keeps everyone comfortable. A heated steering wheel, selectable interior lighting, a 110-volt power outlet, and Conversation Enhancement, which uses the audio system to help front-row occupants be heard in the third row, make the cabin a pleasant place for long drives. Infotainment & Technology A 16.9-inch curved OLED infotainment screen with embedded navigation and voice recognition anchors the dashboard, with a 14.2-inch OLED reconfigurable instrument cluster and a 7.2-inch OLED control panel completing the high-tech look. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep phones connected without cables, and the AKG Studio 19-speaker system delivers concert-quality sound. A head-up display keeps key information in the driver's line of sight, and the rear camera mirror gives a clear, wide view behind the SUV even when the cargo area is full. OnStar services, Wi-Fi hotspot capability, and SiriusXM radio capability add connected convenience. Subscription may be required to maintain service. Safety Features The Escalade is loaded with technology to help watch the road. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, front pedestrian braking, and lane keep assist with lane departure warning help the SUV react when the driver cannot, while adaptive cruise control reduces fatigue on long drives. Lane change alert with side blind zone alert, rear cross traffic alert, rear pedestrian alert, and reverse automatic braking help in traffic and when backing up, and HD Surround Vision and enhanced auto parking assist make it easier to maneuver a large SUV. A safety alert seat can warn the driver with gentle vibrations, and a teen driver feature adds peace of mind for families. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This Escalade Premium Luxury combines flagship presence with serious practicality: seating for seven, up to 121 cubic feet of cargo space, a rich leather interior, a head-up display, a 19-speaker AKG audio system, and a smooth, powerful V8. As a one-owner SUV with a thorough service record, it offers a great deal of luxury and room for the money, and it is ready for the next owner to enjoy. Plenty of room, plenty of power, and plenty of reasons to take the long way home. We will happily evaluate your TRADE-IN and offer EXCELLENT FINANCE OPTIONS as well, so please give us a call at 732-919-0707 (Wall Township) or 856-881-2869 (Sewell) TODAY!
